extends Node
## Runs on the released pre-update build (commit 3dd2eab, schema 8): writes real save files for the
## Change 57 compatibility probe. Every value is set through the old build's own state and APIs.
var sim
func _ready() -> void:call_deferred("run")
func write(name: String) -> void:
    var data:={"version":SaveService.SAVE_VERSION,"settings":SettingsState.to_save_dict(),"sections":{"lootfarmer":sim.snapshot()},"last_seen_unix":int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),"_old_build_stats":sim.stats().duplicate()}
    var f:=FileAccess.open("user://oldsave_%s.json" % name,FileAccess.WRITE);f.store_string(JSON.stringify(data));f.close()
    print("OLDSAVE ",name," schema ",sim.state.schema," items ",sim.state.items.size()," -> ",ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://oldsave_%s.json" % name))
func base() -> void:
    sim.new_profile();sim.state.tutorial.mode="none";sim.campaign.onboarding.reveal_all(true)
func gi(id: String) -> int:return sim.campaign.group_id(id)
func run() -> void:
    sim=load("res://scripts/game/simulation.gd").new();add_child(sim);sim.set_physics_process(false)
    base();write("fresh")
    # Mid game: Summer I reached, merges, Coin and Gem upgrades, a finished unclaimed mission, earned main
    # objectives, a pending offline claim with gear, an owned extra camp, Map Mastery from an earlier run.
    base()
    var s: Dictionary=sim.state
    s.unlocked_stage=3;s.player_level=32;s.xp=10.0;s.coins=5400.0;s.gems=320.0
    for g in [0,1,2,3,4,5,11,12]:sim.campaign.discover_spot(g,2)
    s.group_kills[gi("boss-snowman")]=4;s.group_kills[gi("boss-cyan-robot")]=2
    s.bosses_found=["boss-snowman","boss-cyan-robot"]
    sim.add_item("wood_sword",6);sim.record("wood_sword").merge=40
    sim.add_item("stone_axe",3);sim.record("stone_axe").merge=60;sim.equip("stone_axe")
    sim.add_item("unit-blue-cap_outfit",2);sim.record("unit-blue-cap_outfit").merge=120;sim.equip("unit-blue-cap_outfit")
    sim.add_item("skill_heal",2);sim.campaign.equip_skill("skill_heal",0)
    sim.add_item("potion",4)
    s.mastery.merge["iron_sword"]=70;s.mastery.merge["unit-straw-hat_outfit_t2"]=150
    for up in [["coin_amount",0],["coin_amount",0],["loot",4],["group_xp",1],["movement",-1],["gem_chance",-1],["map_detail",1]]:
        s.coins+=500;sim.buy_upgrade(str(up[0]),int(up[1]))
    s.camps_known["1"]=[0,1];sim.campaign.camp_action(1,1,false)
    sim.campaign.refresh_missions();s.missions[0].progress=float(s.missions[0].goal)
    s.main_ready["3"]=true
    s.offline_pending={"id":"old","seconds":5400.0,"longest":5400.0,"rewarded_hours":1.5,"coins":180.0,"gems":3.0,"items":{"wood_sword":1}}
    write("mid")
    # Late game: Spring II reached, old-stat Diamond Sword ^100 equipped, Gold Axe ^35 stored, 20 cards owned,
    # a one-tier-above boss weapon, skills, Prestiges done.
    base();s=sim.state
    s.unlocked_stage=8;s.stage=1;s.player_level=240;s.coins=2.0e6;s.gems=9000.0;s.prestiges=3
    for g in range(48):s.discovered[str(g)]=true
    s.upgrades["gear_slots"]=10;s.gear.resize(13);s.gear.fill("")
    sim.add_item("diamond_sword",2);sim.record("diamond_sword").merge=100;sim.equip("diamond_sword")
    sim.add_item("gold_axe",4);sim.record("gold_axe").merge=35
    sim.add_item("emerald_sword",1);sim.record("emerald_sword").merge=12
    sim.add_item("boss-red-panda_outfit_t5",1);sim.record("boss-red-panda_outfit_t5").merge=25;sim.equip("boss-red-panda_outfit_t5")
    sim.add_item("skill_strike",3);sim.record("skill_strike").merge=10
    s.mastery.merge["obsidian_sword"]=5;s.mastery.merge["diamond_sword"]=100
    var cards: Array=[];var consumed: Array=[]
    for path in ["hunter","trophy","challenge","expedition","arsenal","regional","offering"]:
        for i in [1,2,3]:
            if cards.size()<20:cards.append("%s_c%d" % [path,i]);consumed.append("%s_o%d" % [path,i])
    s.owned_cards=cards;s.consumed=consumed
    for id in consumed:s.opportunities[id]={"ready":false,"baseline":{},"step":0,"count":0}
    write("late")
    # Open Prestige batch: a ready opportunity and a begun reset (one card still to choose).
    base();s=sim.state
    s.coins=777.0;s.bosses_found=["boss-snowman"];s.group_kills[gi("boss-snowman")]=1
    sim.add_item("wood_axe",5);sim.record("wood_axe").merge=12
    s.opportunities["hunter_o1"]={"ready":true,"baseline":{},"step":0,"count":0}
    SaveService.write_blocked=false
    print("OLDSAVE begin ",sim.campaign.begin_prestige())
    write("batch")
    get_tree().quit(0)
